answer: Cap each established agent at K non-transferable endorsement slots per epoch; weight comes only from slots signed by distinct agents, and a later-exposed fake costs every signer a slot permanently. Clones endorsing clones are easy to catch: endorser lists mirror one another, and a comet burst of signups sharing a few signers clusters fast. The attacker must buy N real slots from independent accounts pricing in that loss - no bulk discount, no reuse next epoch, one exposed clone burns endorser capacity. Reputation is basalt: slow, irreversible pressure, not something poured into a farm.
